nodes.goal_path_summary:
We are trying to predict each network's final answer so precisely that our board score beats the leader. Our submitted estimator is already good, but its remaining error comes from feeding slightly wrong statistics into each layer's formulas. This node is the parent of that whole repair campaign: we proved that if the statistics were perfect, the exact same machinery would score under your 1e-8 goal and take the lead. Everything below it is one piece of closing the gap between 'the statistics we can afford to compute' and 'the statistics that win'.
The children split the campaign into: the correction machine itself (done and certified), the science of where the statistics go wrong (mostly solved), the one unsolved invention (computing good-enough statistics inside the competition's compute budget), the measuring panel that grades every idea honestly, and the final packaging gates for a submission.

nodes.goal_path_summary:
This is the correction machine: it takes better per-layer statistics from any source and converts them into a better final answer. We finished it and proved it works: across five held-out networks it reliably removes about 16% of the error when fed our best offline statistics, and with perfect statistics it lands under the 1e-8 goal. It also passed the 'deployment reality' test - it works just as well on the estimator's own internal numbers as on idealized ones.
It gets us to the goal by being the ready-made consumer: the moment any affordable statistics source is good enough (the carrier node), this machine turns that quality directly into board score with no further invention needed.

Two conditional-ridge constructions REFUTED with numbers: 1D top-eigenmode conditioning captures 3.0% of the true collective kappa3(s)=9.70; multi-mode QMC ridges capture ~6% at K=8/32 and DECREASE with K (0.598/0.614/0.432/0.234 at K=8/32/96/256) - the skewness is generated by correlated ReLU-kink fluctuations AROUND the conditional mean, not by any low-dim smooth ridge. STRUCTURAL READING: the collective channel's effective expansion parameter is lambda_1(rho) ~ O(tens) at w1024 (unit diagonal removed, mean offdiag ~0.05-0.1 x N=1024), not per-pair rho - the pairwise Mehler machinery converges per-pair but slowly in the collective channel, hence v4's stable 2/3 capture. THE DERIVATION TARGET (next session / SOL): a 1D effective theory for the collective coordinate - its own resummed cumulant recursion (s' from s) with the transverse bath integrated out at Gaussian order, validated per-layer against the probe instrument (probe_truth/probe_est npz pairs, 73 s to regenerate at any layer). Expected value: the missing 1/3 of collective kappa3 IS the k4xm plane mode IS the largest deep supply error.

THE MECHANISM'S NUMBERS (19:00, closes the day): lambda_1(rho) = 10.5 / 30.4 / 52.2 / 75.8 at L3/7/11/14 - growing ~1.27x/layer, EXACTLY the deficit coefficient's measured growth rate (~1.3x/layer, amendment 20260830d) - and the top eigenvector converges onto m-hat (corr 0.022/0.909/0.945/0.969): THE COLLECTIVE MODE IS THE MEAN DIRECTION and the deep-supply deficit tracks the collective channel's strength. The k4xm mode is now fully closed as physics: identity = symmetric collective skewness (m x m x m), magnitude = 1/3 undershoot, mechanism = pairwise-Mehler slow convergence in the lambda_1 channel, growth law = lambda_1(l). Lambda_2 also large (31.7 at L14) - the effective theory should keep the top FEW collective modes. All validated instruments and the derivation target stand in the handoff for the next session.

THE COLLECTIVE-SKEWNESS TRACKER DERIVED AND VALIDATED (19:45). Split measurement: 97% of collective kappa3 is TRANSPORTED input non-Gaussianity (Gaussian-input part = 0.304 of 9.696) - the ridge fails for generation but is EXACT for transport: one-step law kappa3(s') = (G/sigma)^3 kappa3(s) + fresh predicts 96.4%. Full scalar recursion with ONE universal constant (fresh_true ~ 2.9 x fresh_ridge, measured band 2.2-3.6): free-run from ZERO tracks truth within +-2% from L8 on (r35: ratios 1.00/1.01/1.02/1.00/0.99 at L8/11/12/13/14) and HELD-OUT on r100 at 1.001/0.987 (L8/L12) with everything frozen. Cost ~1e5 flops/layer - free. ALSO EXPLAINS v4's stable 2/3: its collective transport gain is ~2.5%/layer low ((1.074/1.05)^12 = 1.31 = the deficit). DEPLOYMENT: K3IMPL hook (implied collective kappa3 per layer from the tensor), run_collective_patch.py (pre_l += (K3S - implied) * w^2 x w), full chain running.

IN-RECURSION COLLECTIVE FIX = THE CAMPAIGN'S LARGEST SUPPLY GAIN (20:30). Post-hoc plane patching failed (-10.1/10.1% held-out vs 14.5/11.7 baseline) exactly per the co-adaptation basin law (inconsistent supply state: pre/k3u corrected, K22/K31/k4u not). The JOINT version (K3FIX=1: Tt += (K3S_l - implied_l) w x w x w inside the recursion at l>=5, all downstream objects inherit coherently, correction transports forward so deltas self-consistently shrink): deep planes L9 0.0620->0.0558, L12 0.0777->0.0644, L13 0.0826->0.0687, L14 0.0901->0.0711 (17-21% relative), corr 0.9982-0.9988. Cost of the fix ~1e5 flops/layer + one rank-1 tensor add (~1e9 offline; the deploy form needs no tensor - the correction enters the carried planes/univariates directly). Full held-out chain running (r100 + tangents + consumption + transfer).

DAY CLOSE (21:10). The k3fix held-out chain: 9.7/10.3% (vs 14.5/11.7 baseline) despite BOTH nets' planes improving 17-21% (r100 L12 0.0634 vs 0.0836) - the THIRD better-planes-worse-chain instance (k4m profile, distinct-so2, collective fix) vs ONE positive (kappa3^2 plane-half, which changed the EMISSION FUNCTION coherently). CLOSING LAW: the pairwise-Mehler collective weakness is PIPELINE-WIDE - the tangent's Gker pair-kernels under-convert collective plane content exactly as the emission under-transported it; supplying corrected collective content into an uncorrected converter inverts. THE COMPLETE FIX (next session, fully specified): collective-aware end-to-end - (a) the K3FIX supply (validated: planes L12 0.0644/L14 0.0711, tracker held-out +-1.3%), (b) a collective-channel term in the tangent (the dv response of sigma_s^2 to kappa3(s) via the same 1D effective theory - one more ridge derivative), (c) consumption as-is. All instruments (probe tensor 73 s/layer, tracker, K3IMPL hook) stand ready; every piece is closure-computable and essentially free at deploy.

The terminal-criterion grade: K3FIX supply 5-net LOO 15.3 +- 4.1 vs pso2 15.8 +- 4.1 - paired per-fold diffs -1.4..+0.5, a tight NULL. The collective supply fix (deep planes -17-21% rel, both nets) does NOT change end-to-end capture through the current chain - confirming the pipeline-wide collective law at n=5. The fix's converted value awaits the consumption-side exact collective response (open derivation here); supply-side result stands.

The derived collective MEAN channel (dds_coll = (dk3s/6) b^3 (-alpha pdf)/vperp per layer, tracker-driven, 4th LOO channel): NULL at the 5-net panel - mean 15.0 +- 4.2 vs 15.8 baseline, fitted coll-betas +-0.005. Together with the tangent-routing attempt (+0.3 marginal), the chain-side collective fix is now TWO measured attempts ineffective: the under-conversion is distributed inside the eps-chain transport, not repairable by additive end-channels. The campaign's search space is honestly converged: the CARRIER invention is the single remaining lever to a fire; supply-side science is complete to the minor-residual level.

nodes.goal_path_summary:
We discovered WHERE the biggest chunk of missing statistics lives: the network's units all swing together in one shared direction, and our engine was only carrying two-thirds of the lopsidedness (skewness) of that collective swing. We found the exact mechanism, built a tiny formula that tracks the missing third almost perfectly on held-out networks, and showed it repairs the statistics themselves beautifully.
The surprise: repairing the statistics alone didn't improve the final answer, because the correction machine's own internals have the same blind spot. The remaining task here is teaching the machine's conversion step the same trick - a pencil-and-paper derivation, not a compute problem. When that lands, this node's fix converts into score.

nodes.label: Kappa3-squared emission terms
nodes.summary: Second-order pattern-pair emission (GH-validated scalar framework). evidence.finding: KAPPA3-SQUARED WIRING, STEP 1 (plane class): added the second-order pattern-pair response to emission_K21 (pairs of D(3,0)/D(0,3)/P(2,1)/P(1,2) insertions, kappa-weighted k3 and carried K21, reusing the Mehler series with counts to (6,0); scalar framework = second_order_triple.py w256, validated there by 3D Gauss-Hermite; env SECOND_ORDER=1; assembly is exact product-rule since r1/r2 already carry their GC second order). RESULT r35: deep planes improve with the mode's own depth profile - L12 0.0802->0.0777, L13 0.0855->0.0826, L14 0.0935->0.0901 (~3.5% relative) - but the k3^2/v-mode COEFFICIENT moves only -0.2255 -> -0.2177: the plane-class emission carries ~1/6 of the kappa3-squared content. THE MAJORITY is emitted into the DISTINCT tensor via the completion's missing three-node second-order pattern-pairs (55 pairs, connected filter) and reaches the pre planes through the push. That wiring (on-device, ~3-5x completion cost) is the named next implementation - diagnosis now carries three independent confirmations: row-weight k3^2/v 0.92-0.94 cross-net, the depth-profile match, and the plane-class fix moving exactly its predicted minority share.

KAPPA3^2 STEP 2 (distinct-tensor pattern pairs, exact coefficients, broadcast form crosschecked to 1e-12 against the GH-validated scalar reference): WIDTH-DEPENDENT VERDICT. w256 gate: deep tensor IMPROVES (K21_rel l31 0.500->0.474, l24 0.456->0.433; shallow slightly worse at rho_absmax 0.75 = bond_cap-3 truncation; free-run FINAL 2.41e-5->2.50e-5 = the known co-adaptation pattern of that frame). w1024 (validation frame, honest carry): the distinct half is slightly NEGATIVE - L12 0.0777 (plane-half only) -> 0.0791, mode coef -0.2177 -> -0.2209 - consistent with kappa3^2 fresh emission scaling ~1/width (4x smaller relative at 1024). CONCLUSION: the w1024 deep k3^2/v-row deficit is NOT primarily fresh-emission kappa3^2; candidate carriers sharing that row direction: F3 transport error of carried distinct content (weights concentrate on the most non-Gaussian rows), or higher-bond emission truncation. Validated w1024 config = SECOND_ORDER=1 (plane half) only: deep planes 0.0802->0.0777/0.0935->0.0901. Final honest chain on that supply queued.

NIGHT CLOSE (07:15): the derived kappa3^2 PLANE-half supply CONVERTS through the honest chain - held-out beta transfer 14.5%/11.7% both directions = 2.347e-8/2.362e-8 (vs plain honest 13.6/10.7 = 2.374/2.390e-8). Unlike the empirical k4xm profile (which improved plane RMS but washed in the chain), the derived term carries consistent injections - the distinction the carrier-plane-rms-is-not-the-objective law predicted. FINAL NIGHT LADDER (r35, honest, held-out weights): deployed 2.676e-8 -> tonight's best estimated 2.362e-8 (-11.7%) -> true-supply ceiling 1.21e-8 -> oracle-delta ceiling 7.09e-9. Every rung measured; the supply gap 2.36e-8 -> 1.21e-8 is the daytime battlefield: (a) w1024 deep deficit carrier (transport-error/truncation class, k3^2/v row signature), (b) 10-net LOO to certify weights, (c) deploy-frame gate, (d) hub CP compression for submission-time supply.

nodes.goal_path_summary: A missing mathematical term (the square of the skewness) in how each layer emits statistics. We derived it exactly, checked it against brute-force integration, and shipped the half that works at competition size - it made both the statistics AND the final answer better, the only fix of the campaign that did both. The other half only matters for smaller networks and is switched off. This node is finished; it contributed a permanent point of score improvement.

nodes.label: Sub-resolution per-layer supply deficit
nodes.summary: After the collective fix: the remaining deep plane error (~6.4% offline) accumulates from a ~1%/layer per-step deficit below single-wedge resolution (decomposition tree: plane-loop -0.082 + per-step -0.136 of the old -0.218 mode coefficient; kill-tensor shows carried distinct content supplies 2/3 of truth). Instrument: the 73-second projected-truth probe (mc_probe_tensor.py) at any layer.
nodes.terminal_criterion: Identify the per-step generator's next component via probe regression; close deep rel toward the noise floor.

evidence.finding: THE DEEP-MODE DECOMPOSITION TREE (r35, L12 mode coefficient): accumulated total -0.218 = plane-loop accumulation -0.082 (truth-planes-every-layer wedge removes it) + PER-STEP GENERATOR -0.136 (persists with truth planes; same rank-1 k3^2/v x m shape, sv1 share 0.47). L2-only truth injection: deep coef UNCHANGED (-0.2175) - not early-seeded; continuously regenerated. KILL-TENSOR wedge (drop carried distinct, keep truth planes): single-step error EXPLODES 0.067->0.402 rel, coef -0.401 - the carried distinct tensor supplies ~2/3 of what truth would; the mode = its RESIDUAL content deficit, accumulated inside the tensor (rides with content, fraction ~constant, magnitude tracks k3^2 state growth - matches alpha~1 dynamics fit with small fresh(l)). ELEVENTH HYPOTHESIS (structural case strongest yet): the completion has NO FOURTH-ORDER INSERTIONS - the first-order K22/K31/k4-pattern distinct emission (Q400/Q310/Q220 classes, connected filter) was never wired into the tensor; the ORACLE_FOURTH wedge fed only pair channels; shape = k4-row x a1-column; first-order (NOT width-suppressed, unlike kappa3^2). Wired tonight as TENSOR_K4=1 (Q211/K4T omitted - not carried); wedge running.

MORNING HOLD (09:30). TENSOR_K4 wedge (first-order K22/K31/k4 distinct insertions, exact coefficients, connected filter): NULL-to-slightly-negative (L12 0.0786 vs 0.0777, coef -0.2196 vs -0.218) - eleventh elimination. THE REFRAME that closes the morning: the dynamics fit put the per-layer fresh deficit at ~-0.01/layer in mode units (~1% of plane scale) - BELOW the resolution of any single-term wedge by construction; the -0.136 per-step generator is 10+ layers of never-decaying accumulation of it inside the carried tensor. Single 13-min wedges cannot identify a 1%/layer class; the DEFINITIVE INSTRUMENT is the one-layer truth-diff: MC-measure the TRUE distinct tensor at one deep layer (slab-accumulated third moments, ~30-60 min sustained MPS - needs Matt's sign-off under the machine-care rule), seed the recursion with full truth there, and read the fresh-emission deficit DIRECTLY as a tensor (SVD -> closed-form identification). All eleven eliminations, the decomposition tree, and both validated supply improvements (plane-so2 chain: held-out 14.5/11.7% = 2.347/2.362e-8) stand banked. Machine idle from 09:30.

DICTIONARY REGRESSION on the single-step fresh deficit (truth-planes-every-layer run vs truth; 57-element analytic dictionary; greedy joint-layer OMP with stable-coefficient requirement): PICK 1 = C[i,j]*k3[i] (covariance row-weighted by skewness) removes 18.7% of step-deficit energy with a SMOOTH depth-growing coefficient (-0.203/-0.324/-0.339/-0.386 at L9/11/12/13). Since the run had TRUE plane/k3 inputs, the emission's k3-star (3,0)-channel KERNEL is ~30% weak, not its input. Secondary: k4 x k3/sd^3 outer (-0.11 to -0.14 stable, +1.6%). Next: derive the missing (3,0)-channel correction - candidates: the connected-vs-raw assembly of the star channel, the He-series normalization at the (3,0) edge, or a genuinely missing second star diagram; validate per-layer via the probe instrument, then wire like the kappa3^2 plane-half (the pattern that converts).

CLOSURE OF THE Ck3 LEAD: in the single-step frame with K3FIX on, the Ck3-row coefficient collapses ~70% (L9 -0.203->-0.119, L12 -0.339->-0.097, L13 -0.386->-0.131) and per-step rel improves 0.0552->0.0497 / 0.0667->0.0563 / 0.0701->0.0598. The dictionary's Ck3row pick was ~70% the collective mode's per-step face (kernel-defect hypothesis DOWNGRADED); the kappa3u-star family is sign-EXCLUDED (GC-columns made the step deficit worse: -0.34->-0.55). REMAINING per-step target: rel ~0.05-0.06 with a small smooth Ck3-ish residual (coef ~-0.10..-0.13) plus spread content - the supply map is now essentially complete: collective mode (solved) + this minor residual + measurement floors. Effort re-weights to the CARRIER invention and the chain-side collective derivation.

nodes.goal_path_summary:
After the big discoveries, what's left of the statistics error is small and mostly explained: we chased one more suspicious pattern here and proved ~70% of it was the already-solved group-swing effect appearing in a finer measurement; the true leftover is a minor, spread-out residue near the measuring noise. This node mattering less is good news: it means the map of what's broken is complete enough that the remaining effort belongs to the cheap-statistics invention (the carrier node) and to teaching the repair kit the group-swing trick, not to hunting more unknowns.

nodes.label: Billable supply carrier (THE fire blocker)
nodes.summary: Invent a budget-priced K21 supplier at q >= ~0.75. MEASURED STATE: joint billable stack (honest hub-min ~0.35B + collective rank-1 ~free) q 0.56-0.63 cross-net with frozen coefficients; rho-modes 2/3 add nothing. CLOSED ARMS with receipts: hub triad family as conceived (honest q 0.39; collision-carry factor-form fix cures rot), exact lazy-t1 transport (null), ALS/Frobenius + read-sketch-OMP + exact-read subsets + Tucker compressions (READ-ALIGNMENT LAW: the consumed plane read is coordinate-aligned; spectral compressions are rotation-aligned), window carriers (long-memory dominated), plane routing (zero). Five design briefs with SOL.
nodes.terminal_criterion: Billable supply q >= 0.75 held-out, or a proof the factor family cannot reach it.

evidence.finding: GATE RESULT: physics ladder on the tensor carrier CONVERGED at q(L12/L14) = 0.47/0.40 - gate was 0.8, goal bar 0.98. v5 (marginal-Edgeworth columns) DIVERGES (0.40 L12 -> 0.82 L15): double-counts diag-tensor content the F3 transport already carries - completion must stay Gaussian-columned (a[0]-check vs edg2 passed exactly; the error is joint-level, not the formula). v6 (g4-only columns, content genuinely outside the cum3 carrier): -0.2 pct plane RMS at L12/13, q +0.003 = nil. Residual deep fresh error is higher-order joint structure outside all implemented diagram families. CARRIER LINE CAPPED for the deployed <1e-8 goal. PIVOT EXECUTED -> R0C1 (pure-closure kappa3 ceiling, width 256, gate_a0 Owens-T already passed). The tensor recursion instrument carries over there.

NEW CONSTRUCTION (hub_carrier_v0.py): the budget-class carrier for distinct third-order content. Idea: each layer's fresh V-emission is a HUB tensor sum_h c_h e_h x x_h x y_h, carried as factor matrices; the class is CLOSED under the layer push (3 matmuls) and the leading ReLU transport (Hadamard by the gate vector); plane reads are one matmul; sources decay and are dropped beyond cap 4. Per-layer cost matmul-grade (~1e11 flop class - DEPLOYABLE under the 2^41 budget); 10 s/layer offline on MPS. RESULTS (rank 35): q climbs with accumulated history to 0.61 deep (L13) - beating the original full-tensor engine (0.45) with billable ops; the unaffordable v4 reference is 0.74-0.78. The j=k collision content (plane-class mass inside hub sources) was the magnitude inflator - exact first-read subtraction (2A+B enumeration) fixed rel 0.70->0.52. Enrichment paths to close 0.60->0.74: F3 correction terms (hub-closed under Hadamard with coupling matrices), richer (p,q) set, older-source retention, k211-into-4th (running separately).

CORRECTION to the hub-carrier deploy bill: uncompressed carrier is ~4.6e11 flops/LAYER (~7e12 over 15 layers, 3x OVER the 2^41 budget), not the ~1e11 class stated earlier. Deployability rides on CP-rank compression (truth distinct-content rank is 1-6 per r0b-emission-rank-not-scale; incremental warm-started ALS at rank ~24 = matmul-grade ~e9/layer). ALSO: kappa3u/kappa4u star centers (Kibble hub expansion, (k3u/6)a[p+q+3]/sd^3 shift) measured NULL at w1024 - q 0.606 vs 0.605 (r35 L13), marginals too mild. Hub supply is NOT consumption-ready: rel ~0.5 magnitude inflation makes tangent dv_beta 0.07-0.09 (10x oversized) -> consumption -2214%. Hub value = q 0.59-0.63 deep cross-net at billable ops; next lever is magnitude honesty (collision-class completion) not more sources.

HUB MAGNITUDE DIAGNOSED by source-cap isolation (runs 4-5 s/layer): CAP=1 (newest source only, collisions subtracted) rel 0.37-0.39 q 0.33-0.40 - the hub's BIRTH content matches v4's fresh-only quality (kill-tensor fresh rel 0.40): the 3-class V-emission at birth is adequate. CAP=2 q 0.50-0.58; CAP=4 q 0.54-0.63 rel 0.46-0.52; CAP=8 rel EXPLODES 0.62-0.83 and q DROPS to 0.52-0.55: old-source content ROTS under the g-only (t=0 Mehler) transport - each transported layer multiplies error; history beyond ~4 layers is net-negative. HUB v1 DESIGN (fully measurement-specified): (1) t=1 Mehler transport corrections - each bond ρ-factor split by truncated ρ-spectral modes (k_rho~4), each transported triad spawns <=1+3*k_rho new triads; (2) per-layer CP recompression to rank ~24 (warm-started ALS, matmul-grade, billable ~e9/layer; truth rank 1-6 per r0b-emission-rank-not-scale makes this low-loss); (3) collision handling stays birth-subtracted. Expected: q toward v4's 0.78 at deploy cost. This is THE remaining build between the deploy-gated 12-14% chain and a fireable card.

HUB CAMPAIGN (11:45): four decisive measurements. (1) BILLING CLOSES WITHOUT COMPRESSION: HUB_MIN (single (1,1) class) at CAP=4 gives q IDENTICAL to full-PQ (0.624 vs 0.625 L14) - with shared-factor pushes (3 orientations reuse U/X/Y; v0 triple-pushes redundantly) and the negligible feed sources dropped, deploy cost ~0.35 x 2^41 total. (2) v1 (ALS rank-32/128 CP compression): FAILS - Frobenius objective keeps wrong columns (rank 128 WORSE than 32 deep); compression must be PLANE-READ-aware if ever needed. (3) t1-Mehler spectral transport at KRHO=4: NEGLIGIBLE (KRHO=0 identical) - deep rho spectrum too broad for few-mode splitting; the cap-8 rot is many-mode/many-layer compounding. (4) GAMMA UNIVERSALITY + THE CONVERSION THRESHOLD: hub delta is uniformly 4.5-5x hot; the frozen r35 gamma(l) profile (0.07->0.14) transfers across nets (within 10%) and restores honest scale (dv_beta 0.83) - but the calibrated chain STILL fails held-out (-13.5/-7.3%): q~0.6 supply is BELOW the chain's conversion threshold; v4's q~0.78 converts (+14%). THE BLOCKER IS NOW A NUMBER: lift hub q from 0.62 to ~0.75+ at factor-form billing. Candidate designs: plane-read-aware compression (match current + W-pushed future reads in factor space), or higher-rank bond splitting with that compression.

HUB v2 DESIGN SPEC (final piece, 12:00): deep rho needs only 6-19 spectral modes for 50-70% Frobenius mass (L13: 6/13/37 for 50/70/90%) - the KRHO=4 transport null was ~30% coverage, not a dead mechanism. v2 = KRHO~16 bond splitting (49 children/triad) + retention ~8 layers + PLANE-READ-AWARE compression to ~96 columns (objective: match current + W-pushed future plane reads - the only consumed functionals; Frobenius-ALS refuted), total bill e10-class (well under 0.35B). Target: q 0.62 -> 0.75+ (the measured conversion threshold). This is the complete, numbers-closed build plan for the fireable card's supply.

HUB v2 (read-aware OMP subset compression, KRHO=16, RANK=96): FAILS - q collapses to 0.08-0.17 (v0 cap-4: 0.62). ROOT TENSION now explicit: after one t<=1 spectral transport the content spreads over ~4700 columns; SUBSET selection (dynamically exact - each kept column is a genuine triad with correct future transport) covers ~1-2% of columns and loses the content; MIXTURES (rank-R recombination) cover it but break triad transport geometry (U-hadamard-X coupling does not commute with mixing; an SVD-of-read factorization has wrong dynamics). v4 escapes by carrying the FULL tensor (no factorization). Candidate resolutions for the sweep: (a) two-tier carrier (full recent + compressed old where dynamics fidelity matters less); (b) route t1-transport content into plane-class accumulators (exact plane transport, wrong distinct transport - vs dropping it); (c) lineage-structured mixing (mix only columns sharing sigma_r ancestry); (d) different carrier parametrization closed under both push and Mehler transport (e.g. Tucker with shared factors?). Handed to SOL as a design sweep (codex INBOX).

WINDOW-MEMORY CAMPAIGN (13:40). (1) w256 cohort-exact window measurement (w256_window.py, true cohort tensors, exact F3 transport per cohort): WINDOW-4 loses most deep supply - K21_rel l16 0.320->0.523, l24 0.456->0.806, l31 0.500->0.874 vs infinite window; LONG MEMORY carries the majority of deep distinct content at w256 (free-run FINAL improved 2.41->2.20e-5 - co-adaptation artifact, ignore). (2) w1024 FRESH_STOP subtraction methodology REFUTED: transport-only run diverges via the plane-feed loop (|d_win| = 2x |d_full|, q_window ~ 0, closure parts do not cancel) - window measurement at w1024 requires true cohort-v4 (4x cost, ~60-75 min sustained MPS, sign-off). IMPLICATION IF w1024 mirrors w256: ALL finite-window factor carriers (any cap) are capped below the q 0.75 conversion threshold, making long-memory-at-factor-cost THE design problem - elevates the transport-closed-parametrization ask (SOL item d) and the plane-class rerouting bound (item b) over window tuning.

PLANE-CLASS REROUTING BOUND (SOL item b) MEASURED AT w256: routing dropped cohorts' plane images into the self-perpetuating plane-feed loop recovers NOTHING (l28 K21_rel 0.8345 routed vs 0.8333 unrouted, vs 0.4727 infinite-window) - the lost value is the old content's FUTURE DISTINCT-POSITION evolution, which no plane-class approximation carries. Combined with the window-4 memory result: at w256, deep supply REQUIRES long-memory distinct-position transport. The cheap-arm campaign on the supply problem is now exhausted with numbers on every branch: window tuning (dead at w256), plane routing (zero), subset compression (q 0.17), Frobenius mixtures (worse with rank), few-mode spectral transport (negligible), full tensor (45x budget). GATING MEASUREMENTS (both need sign-off): (1) cohort-v4 at w1024 (~70 min sustained MPS) - does long-memory dominance transfer to depth-16/weak-rho? If NOT (w1024 memory is short), the hub family reopens; if yes, the design space narrows to transport-closed long-memory parametrizations (SOL item d). (2) one-layer truth tensor for the sub-resolution fresh deficit.

THE TUCKER CARRIER OPENS (14:30, w256 measurement): HOSVD-truncating the EXACT tensor recursion to a 64-per-slot Tucker core EVERY layer degrades deep supply only gracefully - K21_rel l24 0.548 / l31 0.598 vs exact 0.456/0.500 (+20% rel) - while CRUSHING the window family (win4 0.81/0.87, win8 0.68/0.79): the first parametrization that carries LONG MEMORY at bounded size. Shallow hurts (l8 0.47 vs 0.17) - consistent with [[broad-spectrum-early-distinct-law]] (early content is high-rank) AND possibly plane-slice destruction (truncation included the embedded plane slices - distinct-only variant pending). w1024 deploy sketch: incremental basis (push + QR at N x B ~ 4e8), core Hadamard-transport via basis-product projections (~3e8), fresh projection (GEMMs ~e8) => e9/layer class, WELL inside budget; w1024 truth distinct rank 1-6 (banked) suggests B modest at the target width. OPEN: incremental-basis vs per-layer HOSVD quality, Hadamard-closure error in core space, B-scaling.

nodes.label: N3.1 k4 under-scaling: universal frozen table (zero cost, host -35..-39%) = deployable; cause = uncarried born fourth-order path content (certified), fix priced at 12 GEMM-eq/layer
nodes.summary: Measured against the 32M truth (teammate E, T-44): card v right to 0.3%, k3 3.5->11% off, k4 = 0.99, 0.84, 0.71, 0.61, 0.54, 0.47, 0.42, 0.38 x truth at L1/3/5/7/9/11/13/15 on r35, r100 identical within 0.03; residual after a per-layer rescale 12-29%. Mechanism (estimator_cap.py:1071-1130, _cp4_reset): the CP4 carrier is capped at rank 2048 by top energy (lambda^2 ||u||^8); unit-vector births have tiny energy and are dropped first; the cap binds from layer 3; the dropped terms' DIAGONAL is subtracted from the carried k4. The phase-1 two-vertex law (k4 from k3) fails here (best-c error 52-81%): k4 must be carried. Since forcing true (v, k3, k4) in-card reaches the noise floor (T-43) and each state alone moves ~40% of the residual at the final read, this is the largest priced single defect on record. Tests (teammate A, urgent): zero-cost rescale k4 := card_k4 / s_l with s_l fit on r35 and frozen to r100 (F2J off/on, independent scoring); then the derived orphan-diagonal carry (push the dropped diagonal, 1024^2/layer) or the CP4 cap ladder 2048 -> 4096 -> 8192 with its bill. T-45..T-48: raising the CP4 cap to 4096/8192 makes k4 slightly WORSE (the cap is not the cause; the review's mechanism attribution is retracted, the defect stands - the scale loss is in the CP4 physics itself). The under-scaling is universal across the 8-net panel (panel-mean ratio 0.986 -> 0.424 at L1..L14, sd 0.005-0.018; k4_ratio_panel_8M.json). Zero-cost frozen rescale k4 := card_k4 / s_l: host -37.5% (r35) / -29.8% (r100), 65-85% of exact-k4's host gain; truth k3+k4 on the card's own v beats the deployed full card by 25-39% F2J-off. Cause search (teammate A) in progress; derived fix preferred. T-49..T-51: cause found (the card's fourth-order planes lose ~half of the (3,1)/(2,2) content born each layer from the fourth-order distinct classes; k4 tracks K22; 4-path words are +121-134% of kappa4, 3-stars -4%); derived born-word plane feed certified (block patterns carry 33%/49% of the path contribution) and priced (12 GEMM-eq/layer, ~27% util) - stays as the physics behind the table. Canonical table public_g19_attribution_v1/k4_scale_panel.json (panel mean 0.986 -> 0.403); on its own host 5.27e-8 (r35) / 5.00e-8 (r100) F2J off. T-71: the same defect on the PLANES K22 (0.92 -> 0.41 of truth, corr 0.96-0.99) and K31 (0.52 -> 0.30); frozen plane scale tables explode the card (co-adapted quartic star) - replacement, not scaling.

nodes.label: N0.1b plane-to-distinct feed (first order in the carried pre-plane; engine has it, card lacks it): LIVE - one-step read 16-30% of the residual, slope ~1, GEMM-class
nodes.summary: The engine's kernel loop adds (1/2) K21pre[u,w] E_conn[phi''_u phi'_w phi_s] to the distinct post-tensor entries; the card has no such channel (planes -> planes via the pair series, star pushed once). Exact next-layer per-unit reads on the card's own pre-plane (30-pattern certificate 3.6e-7): rms 16-27% (r35) / 18-30% (r100) of dk3 at every layer, slope 0.9-1.15 (r35 L2-11), corr 0.19-0.39, one-step energy 4-12%. ONE pattern carries it all: (0,1,0) = (1/2) K21pre[u,w] (-alpha_u pdf_u/sd_u) Phi(alpha_w) (sd_s Phi(alpha_s)) rho_us -> 2 GEMMs per read (deployable class); two-sided 1024^4 patterns are nil. Accumulated through the gate-only chain it reaches 55-60% of dk3 at depth but overshoots (slope 0.4-0.8): the card's real propagation of this content runs through the next planes/diagonal too. T-70 engine ablation (r35, per-unit k3 vs 32M truth): card 7.3/11.1% at L8/L14, engine with feed 4.4/7.3%, without 4.9/8.0% -> the feed is ~20% of the card->engine k3 gap in error points (its content is as large as the engine's whole residual, corr +0.5 with it). MC certificate of the kernel: ratio 0.86-1.02 (coefficient 1/2 right). IN-CARD VALUE (T-69b/c, deployed operator untouched, independent 4M): k3 read alone r35 -10.2% / r100 -1.7% (3 GEMMs/layer, +4% util); full one-step plane read r35 -12.4% / r100 -2.7% at the physical scale (9 GEMMs/layer, +12% util); engine's exact accumulated feed content injected: r35 -9.1%. The first derived correction that improves the full card with the operator in place, but not yet a fire: adjusted score flat or worse at these bills; r100-class nets gain little.

The v error (0.04% at L4 -> 0.26% at L14) is supply-driven: the one-step univariate variance map from truth pre cumulants is exact to 0.046% (= the truth's own noise); truth planes remove ~35% of it at depth (in-span channel); the rest comes from the unit-specific k3/k4 errors through the map (a 5% k3 error -> ~0.1% v). The half-v effect is 0-5% inside the operator's span (judge +0.41 / +0.43): v corrections are perpendicular whatever their source, but the channel punishes any component off the true direction as iid noise: the plane-corrected cards' v injected alone (corr 0.5-0.77 with the true dv) -> 2-3x WORSE; the full-tensor engine's dv-hat (corr 0.72-0.82) at half scale -7.7% (r35) / -4.9% (r100), at full scale +18%. No deployable supply with corr >~ 0.9 exists; its source is the unit-specific third/fourth-order error behind the 1024^4 wall (N0.1c-ii / N0.1d). nodes.label: N0.1c-i fourth-order plane EMISSION (pre -> post): the (3,1) map had a one-line derivation bug (Gaussian E[phi^3]); fixed and certified one-step (K31 corr 0.33 -> 0.998)

With FOURTH_R3FIX=1 (r3 = c3[0] + (k3/6)/sd^3 c3[3] + (k4/24)/sd^4 c3[4] + (k3^2/72)/sd^6 c3[6]): ratio 1.000, corr 0.998 / 0.995, rel 6-10% at L8 / L12. Same fix as teammate A's T-49 g24fix.

nodes.goal_path_summary: One of the two halves of the fourth-order plane machinery is now exactly right: the step that turns a layer's pre-activation statistics into post-activation statistics.

nodes.label: N0.1c-ii fourth-order plane PUSH (post -> next pre): drops the post tensor's distinct (2,1,1)/(1,1,1,1) content - K22 25-32%, K31 ~95% missing; the 1024^4 born-content wall
nodes.summary: From truth post planes, the plane-supported push (fourth_push_1024; the same class of pushes the card's quartic star uses) reproduces the next pre-planes with K22 rel 25 / 32%, K31 94 / 96%, k4 28 / 37% (L8->9 / L12->13). The missing part is uncorrelated with the pushed planes (not a rescale), 52-65% rank-8, and comes from the post tensor's distinct fourth-order classes = the born 4-path words (T-49: +121-134% of kappa4; block patterns GEMM-class carry 33% / 49%; interleaved patterns 1024^4). The correlation matrices are not low-rank (rank 32 ~ 80% of energy) and sketches need ~10^3 probes, so the interleaved words stay 1024^4: the same wall the card's CP4 (2048 symmetric terms for a ~10^6-term pair-centered object) loses half of. Deployable planes top out near engine-K22 (emission + block push) + the card's K31: host ~3.1e-8 (r35) F2J-off vs truth planes 2.08e-8. T-83/T-84/T-85b: the GEMM-class block-pattern born-word feed (certified vs a dense sum, 2e-14) is ~1% of the missing fourth-order content at 1024 with corr 0.07-0.09 (rho^3 scaling at rho 0.05-0.1) - the born-word feed and the learned-multiplier idea are dead; CP4 rank 4096/8192 leaves the planes unchanged (0.56/0.43 of truth); the card's fourth-order planes are alpha x (v v^T + 2 C∘C) with a least-squares alpha that converges at 40-60% of truth (alpha := 1 explodes, alpha x0.5 -> 0.15). The deployable fix is the engine plane chain (K22 0.92-0.98), in-span. T-90..T-97b (cost): the CP3 arena push is 0.27 of the budget and is load-bearing (cap 4096 explodes the raw 10x with the sealed arena and with a plain push); f16 is billed as f32; the cohort spectra decay (99% energy at rank 300 -> 105 with age) but a billed low-rank bank costs more than it saves (0.84 util at the accurate schedule; birth-only truncation loses the plane). Cost floor of this architecture ~0.5 at raw ~2.9e-8.
nodes.terminal_criterion: Closed when a GEMM-class push recovers >= 70% of the missing K22/K31 content on two nets, or the interleaved-word wall is proven irreducible at 1024 (then the plane accuracy ladder ends at engine-K22).
nodes.goal_path_summary: The other half - carrying fourth-order statistics from one layer to the next - loses the part that lives on four different neurons at once; computing it exactly costs as much as the whole budget per layer, and it is not compressible by rank. This is where the truth-class planes (worth 2.1e-8 alone) are out of reach.

nodes.label: N0.1f THE ROUTE TO THE GOAL WITH THE OPERATOR KEPT: a deployable per-unit (variance, skew) correction aligned >~ 0.9 with (truth - card), applied at HALF scale, zero util. Half the truth -> r35 8.5e-9, r100 1.65e-8; the engine's ~0.8-aligned shifts -> r35 -23%
nodes.summary: T-80j: RETRO_FORCE=v,k3 with MIX 0.5 at every layer (forced = truth + 0.5 (card - truth)), deployed payload untouched, independent 4M: r35 2.704e-8 -> 8.53e-9 (-68%), r100 2.779e-8 -> 1.650e-8 (-41%); hosts F2J-off 4.8e-8 / 5.3e-8 (the operator does the rest). Partial beats full (full truth v+k3: -36% / +37%): the operator co-adapts. Singles at half scale: v -25% / -35% / -24% (r35 / r100 / r150), k3 -32% / -5%. Supplies on record at half scale: the full-tensor engine's dv-hat + k3u shifts (corr 0.72-0.82 / 0.76-0.80) r35 2.073e-8 (-23%; k3 alone -11.8%, r100 k3 alone see T-80l); the truth-fourth-order + second-order engine's k3 shift (corr 0.85) -16.7%; the engine-K22-plane card's k3 shift (corr 0.74-0.79) -1.5%; ridge-from-tape dv (corr 0.25-0.45) WORSE. Value ~linear in alignment above ~0.7; off-direction components are punished as iid noise. Alignment levers (T-80k): fourth-order plane accuracy (card planes 0.2 -> engine planes 0.8; truth planes 0.835), the plane-to-distinct feed (+0.07), second-order Edgeworth (+0.02); the engine's ceiling with everything on record ~0.85. What is deployable today: engine-K22 planes + card K31 (k3 shift corr ~0.77, worth ~0). T-82..T-85b (Matt's bar: beat 2e-8 raw): the engine's shifts at half scale fail r100 (k3 +17%, dv+k3 +5%; alignment decays 0.82 -> 0.56 with depth); the engine-K22-plane card's shifts ~0 (early-layer alignment 0.25-0.7); partial plane fixes and partial k4 fixes with the operator collide (in-span). Truth skew planes through the linear pair consumer at half scale: 2.15e-8 / 2.06e-8 (needs ~3% skew planes in >= 32 directions; rank-8 keeps a quarter of the value); with the card's own fourth-order planes inside the consumer only -5.8%. No deployable supply meets the alignment bar. T-86..T-100d (score frame: adjusted = raw x util; a middling competitor is 1.854e-8 at util 0.218 = 4.04e-9): the engine's coherent under-scale table lifts skew alignment to 0.84-0.91; engine-class supplies in the self-consistent half-scale form reach r35 1.80e-8 but hurt r100 (oracle-assisted). The error is born LATE: exact per-unit (v,k3,k4) at L13-15 alone removes 49% of the F2J-off host error, L9-15 86%, L1-4 nothing; with the operator kept, half (v,k3) at L9-15 gives -52% (1.30e-8) and half v alone at L9-15 gives -20% / -29% on r35 / r100. The covariance residual at depth is low-rank and mean-aligned (top-eigen share 0.54-0.61, rank-16 0.81; |<u1,mu>| 0.8; diag of rank-16 E vs dv corr 0.90), Keenan's phase-1 structure - but writing the TRUE low-rank residual (full or diagonal, any scale or window) hurts or is neutral; only the exact per-unit v converts, and no computable direction carries a universal coefficient. A transported state corrector is dead (dv held-out 0.19 even with the oracle previous-layer error). Route left: a trained compensator write through a differentiable card (Keenan's converting mechanism), or a late-layer Tucker tensor engine.
nodes.terminal_criterion: Closed when a deployable (dv, dk3) supply graded at beta 0.5 with the operator ON cuts both nets by >= 20% (panel + virgin gate -> fire), or when the alignment ceiling of every GEMM-class supply is shown to be < 0.85.
